organization.label: Organization
organization.unavailable: We could not check your organizations right now.

shell.testBanner: Test mode. Nothing here charges real money.

wrongMode: Check that you are in Live or Test.

overview.title: Overview
overview.partial: Only the first {{counted}} invoices of the month are in these totals.

customer.anonymized: Record anonymized at the holder's request. Invoices remain.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.hasMore: The month has more invoices than listed.

invoice.title: Invoice #{{number}}
invoice.voidOpen: The customer will no longer be able to pay. The invoice stays visible, as void.
invoice.voidDraft: The draft will be voided without being issued.

credit.title: Credit note
credit.refunded: The money was already refunded through the wallet
credit.refundedNote: Billing only records the refund, it does not send it.
credit.viaPixNote: Inter sends this amount back by Pix to whoever paid the invoice, from its payment. This cannot be undone.

subscription.nowBody: Access is cut now, even inside a paid period. If the customer already paid, issue a credit note.
subscription.endBody: Valid until {{date}}. No new charge after that.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.name: Name
catalog.ownerHint: CTech service the plan belongs to and that receives its webhooks (dfe, finance, billing). Empty if the catalog is yours.

product.note: Prices are not edited: create another and archive the old one. Current subscribers stay as they are.
product.empty: No prices. Create one to allow subscriptions.
product.dunningDescription: Replaces the organization's on this product's invoices. If a subscription mixes policies, the organization's applies.
product.archiveBody: It leaves new subscriptions. Current subscribers keep the same amount.
product.hintFixed: Charged at the start of each period.
product.hintMetered: Charged at period end, on reported usage.
product.priceNameHint: Optional. How the price reads on the invoice and as the plan. Empty uses the product's name.
product.timingHint: In advance bills at the start of the period; in arrears, at the end.
product.timingMetered: A usage price is always billed at the end of the period.
product.metadataHint: Optional. One line per item, key=value (e.g. plan=pro, quota_nfe=1200).

settings.title: Settings
settings.dunningDescription: When to remind, restrict access and write an invoice off.
settings.noLegalBody: The PDF uses the display name, which is a brand. Add the legal name and tax ID.
settings.emailHint: Where customers reply about the charge.
settings.issuerBody: Appears on the PDF of upcoming invoices.

retentionValue.invoices_credit_notes_permanent_audit_5y: Invoices and credit notes kept permanently; audit trail for 5 years

dunning.title: Collection policy
dunning.body: Each step is a day relative to the due date. Applies to upcoming invoices.
dunning.none: No steps of its own. Invoices follow {{label}}.

invitation.title: Bill your customers with CTech Billing
invitation.body: {{name}} can issue invoices, charge subscriptions and get payment webhooks through the API.

points.test: Test mode right away, to integrate safely

invitation.action: I want to bill my customers
invitation.review: Live mode opens after our review.
invitation.pendingBody: While we review, {{name}} can already integrate in test mode.
invitation.rejectedBody: Test mode is still available. See the reason and apply again whenever you want.

send.title: Tell us about the business
send.body: Pick the company that bills and say what it sells.

test.title: Integrate in test mode
test.body: Ready as soon as you send the request.

live.title: Bill for real
live.body: Live mode opens after our review.

apply.title: Apply for billing
apply.description: Tell us a little about {{name}}'s business. Test mode is ready as soon as you send this.
apply.companyHint: Its name and document appear on invoices.
apply.noCompanies: This organization has no company yet. Add one in CTech Account and come back.
apply.about: What you sell and to whom
apply.aboutPlaceholder: E.g. monthly subscriptions to online courses for individuals
apply.contactHint: We let you know here when the review is done.
apply.submittedBody: {{name}}'s test mode is ready. Live mode is under review; we will e-mail you when it is done.
apply.truncated: The list shows the first 200 companies in alphabetical order. If yours is not in it, enter the company's code.
apply.companyIdHint: It is on the company's page in CTech Account.

band.pending: Live mode under review. Test mode is ready for your integration.
band.suspended: {{name}}'s billing is suspended. Integrations can only read data and new invoices are on hold.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Organizations that asked to bill their own customers.
applications.approveBody: This creates live mode and the early access subscription (R$ 0). We e-mail the contact.
applications.rejectBody: Test mode stays. They get the reason by e-mail and can apply again.
applications.rejectHint: Between 10 and 500 characters. Say what they need to fix.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.intro: Your integration calls the CTech Billing API with your own OAuth client, created in CTech Account. Its secret stays with you.
credentials.step1: Create a confidential client in CTech Account with only the integration scopes.
credentials.createClient: Create a client in CTech Account
credentials.empty: No credential connected in this mode.
credentials.byOther: Connected by someone else in the organization on {{date}}
credentials.disconnectBody: Calls from {{id}} to CTech Billing stop at once. The client still exists in CTech Account.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: CTech Billing tells your API when something changes (an invoice paid, a subscription canceled). Every delivery is signed with the endpoint's secret.
webhooks.atLimit: Limit of {{max}} endpoints in this mode. Delete one to add another.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add an https URL of your API to start receiving events.
webhooks.disabledHint: Disabled after repeated failures. Delete it and add it again.
webhooks.tested: Test sent. The result shows on the row within a minute.

form.title: New endpoint
form.urlHint: https only, on a public address. When you add it we send a GET with ?hub.mode=subscribe&hub.challenge=<text>; your endpoint must answer 200 with exactly that text.

secret.title: Copy the secret now
secret.body: It signs every delivery (X-Billing-Signature header) and is not shown again. If you lose it, rotate it.
secret.label: Signing secret
secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select it and copy by hand.

webhooks.rotateBody: The current secret stops working at once. Deliveries that fail while you update your API are retried, signed with the new secret.
webhooks.deleteBody: No event is sent to it after this, including the ones already queued.
webhooks.untested: Not tested yet. Set the secret on your server, then press Test.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: The organization's plan sets how many bank-account charges are included each month.
plan.refuse: Past the limit, new charges are refused
plan.currentOther: Your current plan is {{plan}}, outside the public list.

confirm.title: Change to {{plan}}?
confirm.paid: The {{amount}} monthly fee and the extra charges come together on the invoice at the end of the period.
confirm.free: The Free plan has no monthly fee.
confirm.below: You have already issued {{used}} charges this month and the {{plan}} plan includes {{quota}}. Nothing is cancelled: the limit only applies to new charges and subscriptions.
confirm.atPeriodEnd: The change applies when the current period closes: it is billed under the current plan.

plan.liveOnly: The plan is changed in live mode. In test mode nothing is billed or counted.
plan.scheduled: Changes to {{plan}} on {{date}}, once the current period closes.
